notes: §1985:IX.4.5.4 GR7 admits READ ... INTO "If only one record description is subordinate to the file description entry" or when all record-names and identifier-1 "describe a group item or an elementary alphanumeric item". KeyedIoBinder.BindRead routes the phrase through MoveBinder.BindIntoPhrase to StatementValidation.CheckIntoReceiver (no edition gate; at 85 every group is an alphanumeric group and category national cannot be declared, so ItemCategory.IsAlphanumericOrNational answers the 1985 set); the witness reads two group records into a group. Probes at 85: refused as COBOL1994 a numeric record-name and receivers numeric, signed-scaled, alphabetic, alphanumeric-edited, numeric-edited, alphabetic(1:4); admitted one-record numeric->edited, two alphanumeric records, ODO groups (space-filled), refmod of numeric/alnum-edited (1985 IV.4.3.8.4.4 GR5); PIC N refused COBOL0900; a record-less indexed FD refused COBOL1837 (so arm a's count-0 admission is unreachable here; its sequential twin is PB5071); failed OPEN 35/READ 47 left identifier-1 unchanged; TE(RA) subscript evaluated after the read.

next.reason: 1985: "If only one record description is subordinate to the file description entry, or ... describe a group item or an elementary alphanumeric item"; 2023: "If no record description entry or only one record description is subordinate ... or an elementary item of category alphanumeric or category national". 2023 also permits INTO when no record description entry is subordinate to the FD, and when the items are elementary items of category national. Both are cases 1985 did not allow.
